feed.title: not — notes
feed.subtitle: Short write-ups, usually about something that was broken for an afternoon and turned out to have a one-line cause.

entry.title: adding a window without inflating the binary
entry.summary: The size was the feature, so the windows had to go in a second binary. On splitting swiss into a library with two front-ends, why Cargo silently ignores profile overrides in a member manifest, and why embedded fonts don't replace a toolkit's own.

entry.title: why my certificate wouldn't issue
entry.summary: My DNS was perfect the whole time. The certificate job had simply cached one failed lookup and backed off until it gave up — and there is no button to make it retry.

entry.title: one 1.5 MB binary, three jobs
entry.summary: swiss unlocks stubborn files, edits PDFs and generates branding sets. Notes on using the Windows Restart Manager instead of downloading handle.exe, and why pruning PDF objects cut split output from 1 MB per page to 100 KB.

entry.title: the artwork on this site made itself
entry.summary: Every image here is drawn by a Rust binary I wrote — including the marks, which are a rounded square and a handful of triangles. Also: why the cards are 1280x720 when every guide insists on 1200x630.
